name: Old Tide Door

Painterly industrial noir oil/gouache, textured but detailed, grounded retro-industrial science fiction. No words, readable signs, labels, UI, borders, collage, logos or watermark. No prominent humans or monsters; occupants appear separately in the game. The world outside civilization can be wild and desolate. Do not paint quest instructions or numeric game statistics. Keep main features within central 85 percent for responsive fit. Navigation constraint: there is no vertical travel here. The ceiling is continuous sealed brick or concrete. No ladders, no staircases, no manholes, no shafts, no hatches, no openings overhead, and no daylight from above. Only horizontal tunnels connect this room. Keep its distinctive feature and environment; light comes from lamps.
